capabilities: Add 20 checkbox states with unique SVG icons to Markdown tasks
Cycle checkbox states with a command
Enable, disable, and reorder states in settings
Override icon colors and replace SVG icons
extras: README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian tasks have only checked/unchecked states, with no built-in way to add or display other checkbox states.
summary: Checkbox-state plugin that adds 20 extended task checkbox states with theme-independent SVG icons and a cycling command.
